n8d65089ff1.headline: US chances of doing without Chinese magnets assessed
n8d65089ff1.summary: Chinese rare earth magnet exports to the US have collapsed, ending a months-long recovery in the market amid ongoing trade disputes between the two countries. CNBC was cited as the source.
n8d65089ff1.why: Rare earth magnets are essential components in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and defense equipment, so supply disruptions affect many industrial supply chains. China dominates global rare earth processing.
